title: A Regressor's Tale of Cultivation
altTitles: A Regressor's Tale of Cultivation: Infinite Regression
description: Seven people are suddenly transported into a world of immortal cultivators. While the others awaken with extraordinary talents and abilities, Seo Eunhyeon appears to have nothing special and is forced to live as an ordinary mortal. After living for fifty years, he dies—only to discover that his true ability is infinite regression. Each death sends him back to the beginning, allowing him to experience different lives, cultivate through countless struggles, form new relationships, and gradually uncover the secrets of the cultivation world.
author: Tremendous / KIM MuHyeon
